You let the evening pass.

=== Day 2: the town meeting ===
Jory: "Look, I gotta say it—I don't trust Greta! I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #61, #62]
Greta: "I've got my own reason to suspect Isolde, and no, I'm not laying it out for the Demon yet."  [case board: #63]
Isolde: "Please hear me gently, everyone—I only held back out of fear, but I am the Lamplighter."
Isolde: "The night before you arrived, walking the lamps, I counted 2 others out."
Isolde: "Last night, walking the lamps, I counted 3 others out."  [case board: #64, #65, #66]
Lian: "Here's what the town needs to know to narrow the list: I am the Martyr."
Lian: "Last night, I have given my life over for Isolde, should the town ever hang them."
Lian: "I back Greta's read on Isolde."  [case board: #67, #68, #69]
Isolde: "Please forgive me for speaking on fear alone, yet something about Agnes frightens me."  [case board: #70]
Agnes: "Oh, From my window, I saw Isolde out in the street last night."  [case board: #71]
Hollis: "So that the record is free of ambiguity on this point: I am the Gravedigger."  [case board: #72]
Constance: "I should mention: Last night, I watched the Market: I saw Isolde pass by."
Constance: "I concur with Greta regarding Isolde. My own reading pointed at them."  [case board: #73, #74]
Edda: "Greta has the right of it about Isolde, friends."  [case board: #75]
